items.headline: How the end of “Roe” is reshaping medical care
items.claim_summary: Politico reporter Alice Miranda Ollstein’s new book Side Effects argues that post-Dobbs abortion bans have eroded quality and availability of health care far beyond reproductive services.
items.mission_relevance: Directly engages abortion ethics and claims that protecting unborn life harms broader medical care; raises awareness of selective framing of Dobbs consequences.
items.limits: Book is advocacy reporting; does not establish that bans cause the claimed systemic erosion independent of other factors; anecdotal interviews predominate.

items.headline: When Idaho Banned Abortion, OB-GYNs Fled. The Doctors Who Stayed Are Cracking.
items.claim_summary: Idaho’s near-total abortion ban has driven more than a third of OB-GYNs to stop practicing obstetrics or leave the state, leaving maternity care scarce and dangerous.
items.mission_relevance: Core abortion/war-on-life framing; challenges Christian ethic of protecting the unborn by claiming policy produces medical harm.
items.limits: Cites JAMA study and state numbers but attributes outcomes primarily to the ban; does not control for other workforce or rural factors; individual anecdotes.

items.headline: Thousands protest across Poland for access to free and legal abortions
items.claim_summary: Protests mark the sixth anniversary of Poland’s near-total abortion ban, with activists calling for free, legal abortion and criticizing limited government reforms.
items.mission_relevance: Muslim-source coverage of European Catholic-country abortion politics; frames restrictive law as rights violation.
items.limits: Reports protest numbers and government statements; does not independently verify scale or establish that liberalization is required by ethics or law.

items.headline: How have Democrats’ policies shifted since the last major US election?
items.claim_summary: Some Democratic midterm candidates are moderating on transgender rights while intensifying opposition to Israel’s “genocidal war on Gaza.”
items.mission_relevance: Priority Muslim outlet frames Israel-Gaza as genocide and notes Democratic shifts on trans and war; typical source for contested political-ethical claims.
items.limits: Uses “genocidal war” as settled fact; selective candidate examples; does not establish voter-driven causation or full party positions.

items.headline: In historic first, voters in five states will decide transgender youth rights
items.claim_summary: Five states have ballot measures to restrict transgender athletes in girls’ sports and gender-transition treatment for minors.
items.mission_relevance: Directly contests gender ideology against biological sex reality and protection of girls; Christian ethics on creation order and child safeguarding.
items.limits: Reports ballot facts and local scenes; framing emphasizes “rights” and security presence; does not adjudicate biological or medical evidence.

items.headline: Missouri’s GOP Has a New Strategy to Ban Abortion—Attack Trans Kids
items.claim_summary: Missouri Amendment 3 pairs a constitutional abortion ban with language prohibiting gender-transition procedures for minors, which opponents call deceptive.
items.mission_relevance: Left-leaning outlet treats protection of unborn and of minors from transition as coordinated attack; relevant to abortion and gender ethics.
items.limits: Advocacy framing; does not establish voter confusion or that the linkage is illegitimate; medical claims about transition remain contested.

items.headline: More Than 900 People Have Faced Pregnancy Criminalization After Dobbs
items.claim_summary: Pregnancy Justice data show 902 people charged for pregnancy-related offenses since Dobbs, mostly substance use, with some miscarriage and stillbirth cases.
items.mission_relevance: Progressive framing of fetal-personhood consequences as criminalization; intersects abortion, law, and Christian ethics of life.
items.limits: Advocacy group data; majority are substance-use cases under existing child-endangerment statutes; does not prove Dobbs created new crimes.

items.headline: Israeli forces kill 14 in Gaza as UN commission says genocide continues
items.claim_summary: Palestinian health ministry reports 14 killed in two days; UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry says Israel continues genocidal acts despite ceasefire.
items.mission_relevance: Priority Muslim/anti-Israel source advances genocide claim against Israel; core war and political-ethical contestation.
items.limits: Relies on Gaza Health Ministry and UN commission (contested composition and methodology); does not establish intent or full context of ongoing hostilities.

items.headline: Iran war updates: Tehran in ‘close contact’ with mediators on Hormuz plan
items.claim_summary: Ongoing US-Israel war on Iran continues with Hormuz mediation, Houthi attacks on Aden airport, Hezbollah rejection of disarmament, and US costs exceeding $47 billion.
items.mission_relevance: Muslim-source coverage of multi-front war involving Iran, Houthis, Hezbollah; relevant to just-war ethics and anti-Christian actors.
items.limits: Live-blog aggregation of claims from multiple parties; many battlefield assertions unverified; does not establish strategic outcomes.

items.headline: Feeding Our Future central organizer sentenced to 30 years; federal searches continue in Minnesota
items.claim_summary: A major Feeding Our Future defendant received 30 years; federal agents executed searches at Minnesota childcare and social-service sites amid ongoing fraud probes tied in part to viral independent reporting.
items.mission_relevance: Local Minnesota fraud involving public funds, with heavy Somali-community concentration in convictions; intersects honesty, stewardship, and political claims.
items.limits: Sentencing is court fact; broader $9B estimates remain prosecutorial projections; community-wide characterizations contested; Nick Shirley video claims partially discounted by inspectors.

items.headline: Group says biology-based sports amendment advances in MSHSL process
items.claim_summary: Make It Fair Minnesota reports that 11 member schools have advanced a proposed MSHSL bylaw change returning sports eligibility to biological sex.
items.mission_relevance: Minnesota local contest over sex-based sports categories; protects female athletes against male advantage; Christian ethics of created sex.
items.limits: Organization claim of threshold met; process still requires regional votes; does not yet change policy.
